description: Global application settings applied to every user and client app

scope.title: Global application settings
scope.body: These are global application settings — they apply to every user and every client app, not just your account. Changes take effect as soon as a section is saved.

status.viewOnly: View only — you don't have permission to edit settings.

hints.appIcon: One shared project icon used by every platform (iOS, Android and web).
hints.maintenance: While on, every client/mobile API route answers 503 with the maintenance message. This CMS dashboard keeps working; existing and new client sign-ins are blocked until you turn it off.
hints.registration: When off, new client sign-ups are rejected (403). Existing client accounts can still sign in.
hints.lock: Installed app versions strictly older than the minimum version must update before they can continue. Equal or newer versions keep working normally.
hints.versionMin: Older than {version} must update · {version} and newer continue
hints.image: {formats} — up to {max} KB and at most 4096×4096 px.
hints.legalText: The app displays this text when available. Otherwise, it uses the external link.

editor.placeholder: Write here… Markdown formatting is supported (bold, headings, lists, links).

maintenance.title: Enable maintenance mode?
maintenance.body: All client and mobile API routes will immediately return 503 with your maintenance message. The CMS dashboard stays available, but existing and new client sign-ins are blocked while it is on.

lock.title: Force an app update?
lock.body: Devices running a version older than the configured minimum will be blocked until they update. Double-check the minimum version and the store link before enabling.

removeImage.title: Remove this image?
removeImage.body: The current file is deleted from the server when you save this section.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.body: You have unsaved changes on this page. Leaving now will discard them.

readonly: This field type ({type}) isn't supported by this dashboard version, so it's shown read-only.

validation.version: Use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH — digits only, no leading zeros or suffixes (e.g. 1.10.0)
validation.url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
validation.phone: Only digits, spaces and the characters + ( ) . - are allowed
validation.imageType: This file type isn't allowed. Use: {formats}
validation.imageSize: The image is too large — the limit is {max} KB
validation.imageDimensions: Image dimensions must be at most {max}×{max} px
validation.imageUnreadable: This file doesn't look like a valid image
validation.lockBlocked: The update lock needs a minimum version and a store URL first
validation.lockNeedsVersion: A minimum version is required while the update lock is enabled
validation.lockNeedsStore: A store URL is required while the update lock is enabled
